regional_summary_6h.headline: Iran strike fallout dominates; Armenia legal and extradition rows add regional pressure
bullets: Vance says the US is investigating a strike on an Iran wedding, keeping the US-Iran military track active and elevating escalation risk in the eastern border environment.
US Treasury announced the EU is joining the economic pressure campaign against Iran, deepening diplomatic isolation that can spill into border-security pressure.

In Armenia, commentators flagged open erosion of rule-of-law principles, Yerevan declined to extradite journalist Ilya Danilov to Russia, and Azerbaijani media continue to contest Armenian claims over Artsvashen.
regional_summary_6h.watch: Watch for follow-on US action or Iranian retaliation tied to the wedding strike.
